verdicts.claim: Blake Street Tavern is a long-running game-day bar near Ball Arena
verdicts.note: Checked live: the original closed in 2023. Its 2301 Blake St space reopened in June 2026 as Tavern on Blake Street, under new owners. Renamed and re-described.

verdicts.claim: Great Divide Brewing has a RiNo / Ballpark taproom near the arena
verdicts.note: Checked live: Great Divide closed its Ballpark taproom and RiNo Barrel Bar in June 2025 (new owner Wilding Brands). A return at 3040 Blake St was reported but is unconfirmed. Swapped in Denver Beer Co. and fixed the beer insight.

verdicts.claim: Chauncey Billups is a coach and Hall of Famer whose name is safe to feature in a Colorado hoopers capsule
verdicts.note: Checked live: Billups is a defendant in the federal rigged-poker case. He pleaded not guilty, and trial is set for Nov 2026 with a delay requested. Cut him from the product hook, dropped 'coach', added a do-not-build warning and put Fat Lever in his place among the fanbase icons.

verdicts.claim: Colorado State and Denver are part of a Mountain West / Big 12 college map
verdicts.note: Colorado State joins the rebuilt Pac-12 in 2026-27. Denver plays in the Summit League. Only Air Force and Wyoming are Mountain West. Conference references rewritten, from model knowledge, so confirm the CSU move.

verdicts.claim: 'Mile High Magic' is common fan shorthand for late-game home runs
verdicts.note: No known basis as a real local phrase. Removed from the vocabulary.

verdicts.claim: Nuggets navy hex is #0D2240

verdicts.claim: Skyline Blue #1D428A in the palette

summary: Eleven dossiers and the brief were audited against the CURRENT FACTS and matched on roster, coach, record, DeRozan, Oct 22, Dec 25 and the Cup group. Three live spot-checks found real errors. Blake Street Tavern closed in 2023 and reopened under a new name. Great Divide closed its Denver taprooms in 2025. Chauncey Billups faces a pending federal case, so he came out of the product ideas. Other fixes: college conferences (Colorado State to the Pac-12), the navy hex, a wrong palette entry, the 1990s uniform colors, a James Beard category, and unsupported claims (white-out, Mile High Magic, 2018 revival). The brief has timing problems. The September CRUSH Walls reveal has passed, an Oct 22 launch lacks lead time, and the Marade route and Oct 22 home-opener framing are unconfirmed. About 20 named businesses, festival dates and partners stay queued as unverifiable.
